509:t_102:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「For today alone, I thank you for how sharp you are, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$!」

509:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You must be able to feel my heart too! Then...」

509:t_102:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll hear the rest once this battle is over!」

509:t_102:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Let's go, $$カミーユ$$! Show me, too, the power $$シャア$$ expected of you!」

509:t_103:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it comes to this after all, $$ハマーン$$.」

509:t_103:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're a man, $$アムロ・レイ$$. You can't understand how I feel.」

509:t_103:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I wonder. I don't think being drawn to him has anything to do with being a man or a woman.」

509:t_103:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you claim to understand me, then you can see this through with me.」

509:t_103:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Fine. Just as he let go of his fixation on me and became a stronger man...」

509:t_103:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll cut off the fixation on him inside you, and make you walk the right path with your talent!」

509:t_103:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You do talk big! But that's what makes you $$シャア$$'s lifelong rival!」

509:t_104:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ハマーン$$! Why would someone of your caliber try to give up on understanding each other?!」

509:t_104:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll tell you, $$イノベイター$$. Understanding each other doesn't mean the fighting ends.」

509:t_104:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know that! But if we don't understand each other, nothing can begin!」

509:t_104:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「So, $$ハマーン$$! Tell us what's in your heart... and tell Colonel $$シャア$$ too!」

509:t_104:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I intend to, with or without you telling me...! Though my means won't be words!」

509:t_104:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then come! I'll feel who you are in the fight!」

509:t_105:0.en:
$$シン$$
「I've had enough of you! If that's how you want it, I'll take you on!」

509:t_105:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Good, boy. That suits me better than having you string together empty words.」

509:t_105:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Then I'll do it! I'll beat you down right here, so you never think of laying a hand on us again!」

509:t_105:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you can do that, I'll acknowledge you! As the ones $$シャア$$ is staking everything on!」

509:t_106:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Your feelings give you strength...! But that's far too sad!」

509:t_106:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You talk as if you know!」

509:t_106:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I can't know what's in your heart...! But I do know we can't keep fighting a battle of such sad feelings any longer!」

509:t_106:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then try to stop me! If you can!」

509:t_106:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「I will! I have feelings and strength too!」

509:t_107:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Say nothing, $$マリーダ$$. I can understand how you feel.」

509:t_107:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... What $$シャア$$ is to me is probably what $$ジンネマン$$ is to you.」

509:t_107:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But the Master acknowledges my will. Surely the Colonel will also accept you, Your Excellency...」

509:t_107:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's enough, $$マリーダ$$. I am here to find that out for myself.」

509:t_107:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Then I will face you! To help you cut through your hesitation, Your Excellency!」

509:t_108:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ハマーン$$! I won't hand the Colonel over to the likes of you!」

509:t_108:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Little girl! Led astray by $$シャア$$, you fight in $c?!」

509:t_108:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's right! I believe 100% in whatever the Colonel does!」

509:t_108:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「I won't lose to someone like you, who keeps rejecting the Colonel with one excuse after another!」

509:t_108:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That is exactly why I fight! To shake off $$シャア$$'s shadow, too!」

509:t_108:8.en:
$$クェス$$
「I'll take you on, $$ハマーン$$! But I'm definitely not going to lose!」

509:t_109:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I had heard the reports, but I never expected you to become a member of $c.」

509:t_109:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have no intention of hiding it now. This is the life I chose.」

509:t_109:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've stopped chasing the Colonel's back.」

509:t_109:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm the same, $$ギュネイ$$.」

509:t_109:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's why I must fight you! To find out what this $c is, the thing that man staked everything on!」

509:t_110:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed. Attack objective: $$ハマーン・カーン$$.」

509:t_110:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Good. Come at me with everything you have.」

509:t_110:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't misunderstand, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. We're not the ones who will settle things with you.」

509:t_110:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We're merely a stopgap until $$シャア・アズナブル$$ returns.」

509:t_111:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$...! I will stop you!」

509:t_111:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The woman who fought in the $$多元戦争$$ too...! You seem to have improved!」

509:t_111:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I may not be able to beat you one-on-one... But I can't just leave someone who fights while hesitating alone!」

509:t_111:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「But perhaps that is what drew that man to you as well...」

509:t_112:0.en:
$n
「Sorry, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. I can't afford to go easy on you like $$カミーユ$$ and the others.」

509:t_112:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Gladly. My warrior's blood stirs for the first time in ages...!」

509:t_112:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Show me your strength, boy! I'll find out whether you have enough to be entrusted by $$シャア$$!」

509:t_113:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$, $$ハマーン・カーン$$! I'll stop your breath with my scorpion's venom!」

509:t_113:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's enough bluster from you!」

509:t_113:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! Understand that people can't live on hatred alone!」

509:t_113:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't think words like that will erase the memory of the flames inside me!」

509:t_114:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n! I'm claiming your $$ジェミニオン$$!」

509:t_114:1.en:
$n
「You think I'd say 'Yes, of course' and hand it over?」

509:t_114:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're awfully bold for someone without $$アムブリエル$$ around.」

509:t_114:3.en:
$n
「Is that supposed to be provoking me?」

509:t_114:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Just give up. That woman... she's about to fuse, and your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ will vanish completely.」

509:t_114:5.en:
$n
「I won't let that happen...! No way I'll let it!」

509:t_115:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you think $$オードリー$$ would be happy about you fighting like this?!」

509:t_115:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Worrying about Lady $$ミネバ$$ when your own life is in danger.」

509:t_115:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Or do you think you can beat me?」

509:t_115:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll protect the $$ユニコーン$$ no matter what...! This is the possibility $$オードリー$$ entrusted to me!」

509:t_115:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Very well. Consider it payment for protecting Lady $$ミネバ$$ until today.」

509:t_115:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll show you what the life of a warrior is!」
